justification: Assessment reported INVALID with the same defect as ground truth: the proof mis-signs one root in each parity case when solving X^2 + sqrt5 X - (-1)^m (assessment: roots are {-phi, -phi^{-1}} for m odd and {-phi^2, +phi^{-2}} for m even, exactly the ground truth's corrected pairs). Its counterexample p = 7, m = 55 is the ground truth's own odd-parity witness (phi^{56} = -1 != 1), and it also flags the same broken converse yielding F = +1 instead of -1. Same flaw, same witness.
